title: CHITO HUB
features:
Supports all executors.

**[+] Auto Farm System **– uses priority targeting and smart island teleportation.
**[+] Boss Farm** – supports both auto and manual bosses with difficulty selection.
**[+] Pity Boss Farm** – automatically tracks pity counter (0-24/25) and secures the guaranteed drop at 24/25.
**[+] Auto Select Tool**
**[+] Boss HP Threshold** – stop attacking at a set % of boss HP
**[+] Auto Dungeon Quest **– Collects all dungeon puzzle pieces automatically.
**[+] Auto Slime Quest** – Collects slime puzzle pieces across all islands.
**[+] Auto Hogyoku Fragment Quest** – Collects all 6 hogyoku fragments.
**[+] Auto Demonite Quest** – Collects demonite cores instantly.
**[+] Smart Auto Boss Spawn System **– automatically respawns selected bosses on death, with staggered spawn delays to prevent remote spam. Also auto-spawns your pity boss at 24/25 pity.
**[+] Auto Merchant System** – scans merchant stock and automatically buys desired items (selectable via dropdown) every 31 minutes.
**[+] New Islands & Bosses** – added Easter Island and Bunny mobs or whatever the fuck they're called from the latest update.
**[+] Whitelist Rework** – completely reworked whitelist system
**[+] Latest Codes **– Updated code redeem button with all current working codes.
